name: Economics
notes: The 44-point minimum comprises 35 economics points, six mathematics points and three statistics points. Up to four of the nine economics lecture courses may count through approved outside credit.

Finish the economics core by spring of junior year. Taking a core course in senior fall requires written permission. The department requires C− or above in courses for the major and accepts a P in Principles of Economics.

At least five economics lecture courses and the senior seminar must be taken in the Columbia Economics Department. ECON UN3025 and UN3265 count as Columbia courses, including when taught by Barnard faculty. Transfer, placement and exam credit depend on department approval and school records.

notes: The bulletin specifies 26 economics points, six mathematics points, three statistics points, three business points and 12 prescribed elective points. Complete the finance core by senior fall and take UN3025 or GU4280 at Columbia.
